original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）戈马武装冲突致孤儿童通过教育与互助寻得希望
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 在刚果（金）东部戈马，武装冲突的后果持续严重影响儿童，暴力、流离失所与家庭分离给他们留下难以估量的创伤。当地非政府组织“弱势群体撒玛利亚援助会”（SAV）正为这些儿童提供心理社会支持、教育和健康意识宣传。该地区埃博拉疫情复燃进一步加剧了这些挑战。

location.raw_text: Goma, in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）东部戈马的武装冲突后果持续严重影响儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In Goma, in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo, the consequences of armed conflict continue to weigh heavily on children.

key_facts.fact: 暴力、流离失所和家庭分离给部分儿童留下难以估量的创伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: For some, violence, displacement and separation from their families have left deep and difficult-to-measure scars.

key_facts.fact: 当地非政府组织SAV为儿童提供心理社会支持、教育和健康意识宣传
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the NGO Samaritan Assistance for Vulnerable People (SAV) is focusing on psychosocial support, education and health awareness.

key_facts.fact: 该地区埃博拉疫情复燃加剧了儿童面临的挑战
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The resurgence of Ebola in the region has added to these challenges.

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源，尚未获得其他独立来源交叉验证
儿童所受创伤的具体程度难以衡量
